### @vscode/codicons

```text
Codicons (the icons of Visual Studio Code)
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons

The icons are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

Bash Explainer copies eleven of the icons (collapse-all, expand-all, copy, book, arrow-left, gear,
chevron-down, list-tree, comment-discussion, warning, info) from src/icons/*.svg of @vscode/codicons
0.0.46-24, unmodified, as SVG path data drawn in the theme's colours, in the header of the extension's
panel, in the top bar and the hover cards of the web page and beside the notes of an explanation.
The licensor offers the icons as-is and makes no representations or warranties of any kind concerning
them (Section 5 of the license).
```

of VS Code 1.143.1: the TextMate rules that give a foreground, the semantic token colours and the includes) into
